questions.markdown: Explain the operation of a center-tapped Full Wave Rectifier with a neat circuit diagram and waveforms. Derive the equation for $V_{dc}$, $V_{rms}$ and efficiency considering ideal diodes.

A half-wave rectifier with a capacitor filter is supplied from a transformer having a peak secondary voltage of 20 V and frequency 50 Hz. The load resistance is 560$\Omega$ and the capacitor used is 1000$\mu$F. Calculate ripple factor and dc output voltage. Draw the filtered output and label peak and dc value.

Draw the circuit of a Zener voltage regulator. The Zener diode in a regulator circuit has a breakdown voltage of 15 V, a minimum current of 1 mA, and a power rating of 0.5 W. The series resistance connected in the circuit is 1 k$\Omega$. If the input voltage applied is 40 V, find the range of load resistance that can be connected to prevent the Zener diode from being destroyed.

i) With the help of a truth table, obtain the Boolean expression for a 4:1 Multiplexer and implement it using basic gates.

ii) Perform $(19.25)_{10} - (10.75)_{10}$ using 2's complement method.

Define CMRR for an OPAMP. When the voltage applied to the non-inverting terminal, $V_1$ is 0.25 mV and the voltage applied to the inverting terminal, $V_2$ is - 0.25 mV, the output voltage of the OPAMP is 4 V. For the same OPAMP, when $V_1 = V_2 = 0.5$ mV, the output voltage is 6 mV. Calculate CMRR.
With a neat circuit diagram and relevant waveforms, explain the working of a square wave generator.
A (7,4) bit Hamming code received is 0011101(P1P2D3P4D5D6D7), considering even parity. Check for errors in the received code and if there is an error, write the corrected code.
With a neat circuit diagram and truth table, explain the working of 4:1 multiplexer using basic gates.
Design a 2-bit Ripple down counter using negative edge triggered JK Flipflop. Draw the timing for the same.
